# TESS Program G09166

Title: Copas: Compact Objects And The Physics Of Accretion Survey

PI: Rivera Sandoval, Liliana - University Of Texas Rio Grande Valley

Type: SMALL

Summary: AM CVns are H-deficient accreting white dwarf binaries with 5<P_orb<70 mins. Recent outbursts observations have demonstrated their unique behavior, challenging traditional accretion models, but their understanding is very limited given the small number of known systems. Very often AM CVns are misclassified as H-rich cataclysmic variables (CVs) by ground-based surveys given the limited photometric coverage. We propose to perform a TESS survey on 7340 white dwarfs candidates with AM CVn-like colors to uncover the hidden population of outbursting AM CVs. We will refine the AM CVn population density estimate, while studying their outburst characteristics. Our project will also provide to the community a catalog of transient CV ligthcurves to be used for observational/theoretical studies.
